I heard about the conch horn. …Wait a moment. I've heard the sailors' souls are bound to the captain. If you bring the captain down, won't Elric vanish along with her? I've waited fifteen years — am I going to erase my own brother by my own hand?
Talk to Oscar the fisher.

(Isabel opens a book of maritime law.) "When the captain falls, those bound to her are released. The captain goes down with the ship." …Released. I'll believe that. Go. And tell the captain for me: thank you, all the same, for taking Elric along.
Oscar the Fisher: The captain let Elric take the helm. He bragged about it in his letters.
Oscar the Fisher: Why would someone like that trust the route? What words did the Grey Cloak use to lure her?
Oscar the Fisher: …I'll lay the blame on that cloak. Not on the captain.

Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (14/19)
The Logbook
I'll thaw the logbook and read it. Just give me a moment.
Leave the logbook with Archivist Isabel.

"The scholar in the grey cloak sold us a route, saying it led to where 'the eighth Eye' lies. At the end of that route we met a storm, and the sea froze." And this stone was tucked between the pages… engraved with a storm pattern. The last page lists the locations of the seven seal structures. One page seems to have been hidden on purpose.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (15/19)
The Song Beneath the Ice

The captain said it, didn't she. That the sailors are still singing beneath the ice. …The tortured souls. That song was Elric and the crew. Take my lantern. When you bring the souls down, the lantern will gather them in. Don't hate them.
Defeat 10 tortured souls in the ice maze and gather them into the lantern.
(Countless tiny lights flicker inside the lantern.) …Do you hear that? The song has stopped. Instead someone is laughing. Loudly. That's Elric.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (16/19)
The Heart That Can't Let Go
The souls are gathered in the lantern. Elric too. (Oscar peers into the lantern.) As long as I keep this lantern, Elric is here. After fifteen years. …But it looks so cold inside.
…I'll do as you decide. Sea folk send their own back to the sea. Or rather — some people aren't ready to let go yet.
Oscar the Fisher: Elric, are you listening? It's your brother.
Oscar the Fisher: For fifteen years I lit a lantern. So you wouldn't lose your way.
Oscar the Fisher: …Surveyor, you decide. I can't.
Open the lantern and send the souls out to sea.
Leave the lantern with Oscar. It isn't time to say goodbye yet.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (17/19)
The Thawing Sea, Abyss Floor 2
The sea is starting to thaw! The fishers say they'll cast their nets again tomorrow. And there are reports that floor 2 of the Spiral Abyss has opened. They say floor 2 shows the memory of the sea.
Clear floor 2 of the Spiral Abyss.
In the Abyss you saw someone in a grey cloak handing Cornelia a chart? You couldn't see the face… but the hand wore a glove? My mother's last page mentioned a glove too.
Spiral Abyss, Floor 2

A gloved hand passing over a chart.
"The eighth Eye lies at the end of this route, Captain."
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (18/19)
Casting the Net Again
The sea has thawed. This morning I cast my net for the first time in fifteen years. …Will you help me haul it in? It's too heavy to haul alone.
Haul in the first net with Oscar the fisher.

(The net is full of flapping silver fish.) The sea is honest. It gave back as much as I waited. Fifteen years' worth at once. Haha! …Thank you. Now go see the Elder. He'll be waiting to hear about the logbook.
Chapter 3: Logbook of the Frozen Sea (19/19)
Map of the Seven Seals
I hear the logbook holds the locations of the seven seals. Bring it here.
Tell Elder Erwin the locations of the seven seals.
The seven seals… at last. (The Elder's voice trembles.) Well done, very well done. Now let us go and 'inspect' the seals. I'll guide you myself. …A hidden page? Never mind it. Seven is enough.
End of Chapter 3, "Logbook of the Frozen Sea." The sea has thawed.

Inspecting the Seals

The seals are wavering. We must 'inspect' the seven seals one by one. At each seal a guardian will have awakened. Bring it down and the seal's Eye is revealed. Bring the Eyes to me. I'll keep them safe.
Hear Elder Erwin out.
Thank you. A thousand years… no, I've waited a long time. The first seal is the Soul Forge in the Nether. (The Elder straightens his glove. The inside of the glove glows faintly.)
Elder Erwin of the Order: The seven seals are where the seven kings divided and imprisoned the fire a thousand years ago.
Elder Erwin of the Order: Each seal still holds its kingdom's tragedy. The guardians stand watch over that tragedy.
Elder Erwin of the Order: I'm sorry to ask this of the Corps. But I… cannot go with these hands.
